title: ws: prefer actor pattern to `StreamExt::split`
author: vilgotf
body_preview: Axum's WS documentation highlights the `StreamExt::split` method for independent send & recv tasks. This is, however, just an `Arc<Mutex>` wrapper (with all of its inherent performance overhead). The [actor pattern](https://ryhl.io/blog/actors-with-tokio/) for I/O resources is a higher performance alternative.
